cohort: 816 nulliparous women with gestational diabetes mellitus
finding: ELA was associated with a decreased rate of caesarean section, an increased occurrence of assisted vaginal delivery, and improved maternal and neonatal outcomes in nulliparous women with GDM.
mod_finding: This study found that epidural labour analgesia (ELA) in first-time mothers with gestational diabetes was associated with a lower rate of cesarean section and an increased rate of assisted vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight increased in the ELA group
